mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.1%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signal a broad-based demand contraction, triggering a sell-off in equities and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing supply contraction regime (INDPRO below 98.0), reduced industrial production lowers corporate output and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 98.0, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1 growth above 2.0% annualized) signals strong economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 growth is above 2.0% annualized, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 0.2 percentage points from the prior month signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2pp, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signal a weakening labor market, reducing consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market recovery regime (HOUST above 950.0), increased residential construction activity boosts related sectors and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 950.0, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
